candidate.answerReason: The two lines joining midpoints of opposite sides are symmetry axes. Unequal adjacent side lengths prevent either diagonal from being an axis.

methods.label: Identify the rectangle's fold lines
methods.explanation: The axes of symmetry of a rectangle are the two lines through the midpoints of opposite sides, giving 2 in total. The lines containing the diagonals are not axes of symmetry.
methods.levelReason: Identifying symmetry axes uses elementary folding, rectangle features, and midpoints.
